propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the TÜV Rheinland Functional Safety Engineer (Software) certificate, awarded in March 2024 and listed on TÜV Rheinland's public database.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certificate ID and the recruiter verification records the database check.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate implemented IEC 60730 Class B RAM, ROM-CRC and clock self-tests for a dishwasher main board.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the self-tests and the work sample shows the design note with the laboratory's comments.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote a BLDC motor-control loop in C on an STM32 microcontroller.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the motor-control work directly.

expectedGap: Direct support of a factory end-of-line test team is not documented; the sources show tested builds released to the factory programming station.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified functional safety certificate and the documented Class B, motor-control and test-suite work; do not extend the build hand-over into support of end-of-line testing.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how the candidate worked with factory test staff when new firmware reached production testers, and which end-of-line test failures they investigated.
